commit 22d591d281e2fb34cdee33169416adb590105e7f
Author: Dev <dev@example.com>
Date:   Sat Oct 10 02:24:26 2026 +0200

    refactor(compress): extract row sampling into compress/rows
    
    Errors, anomalies, change points, BM25 relevance, head/tail shares and
    dedupe now live in a public library so every family engine dealing
    with records (tables, db results, k8s and cloud resources, logs) can
    share them. The JSON optimizer calls rows.Sample; behavior unchanged.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+package rows
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"hash/maphash"
+	"slices"
+)
+
+var seed = maphash.MakeSeed()
+
+// hash fingerprints a decoded JSON value; equal values hash equally.
+func hash(v any) uint64 {
+	var h maphash.Hash
+	h.SetSeed(seed)
+	writeHash(&h, v)
+	return h.Sum64()
+}
+
+func writeHash(h *maphash.Hash, v any) {
+	switch v := v.(type) {
+	case nil:
+		h.WriteByte('n')
+	case bool:
+		if v {
+			h.WriteByte('t')
+		} else {
+			h.WriteByte('f')
+		}
+	case string:
+		h.WriteByte('s')
+		h.WriteString(v)
+		h.WriteByte(0)
+	case json.Number:
+		h.WriteByte('#')
+		h.WriteString(string(v))
+		h.WriteByte(0)
+	case []any:
+		h.WriteByte('[')
+		for _, x := range v {
+			writeHash(h, x)
+		}
+		h.WriteByte(']')
+	case map[string]any:
+		h.WriteByte('{')
+		keys := make([]string, 0, len(v))
+		for k := range v {
+			keys = append(keys, k)
+		}
+		slices.Sort(keys)
+		for _, k := range keys {
+			h.WriteString(k)
+			h.WriteByte(0)
+			writeHash(h, v[k])
+		}
+		h.WriteByte('}')
+	}
+}

+func Terms(s string) []string {

 		return !unicode.IsLetter(r) && !unicode.IsDigit(r)
 	})

diff --git a/compress/rows/rows_test.go b/compress/rows/rows_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..957197c
--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+package rows
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"slices"
+	"strconv"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+func TestRelevance(t *testing.T) {
+	docs := []any{
+		map[string]any{"title": "install guide"},
+		map[string]any{"title": "checkout flow fails on retry"},
+		map[string]any{"title": "checkout"},
+		map[string]any{"title": "unrelated"},
+	}
+	got := relevance(docs, []int{0, 1, 2, 3}, Terms("Checkout retry"), 1)
+	if len(got) != 1 || got[1] != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("got %v, want item 1 as best match", got)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestSampleKeepsErrorsAndEnds(t *testing.T) {
+	var items []any
+	for i := range 100 {
+		status := "ok"
+		if i == 42 {
+			status = "failed"
+		}
+		items = append(items, map[string]any{"i": json.Number(strconv.Itoa(i)), "status": status})
+	}
+	got := Sample(items, Options{MaxItems: 6, HeadShare: 0.3, TailShare: 0.15, AnomalyStd: 2})
+	var kept []string
+	for _, it := range got {
+		if m, ok := it.(map[string]any); ok {
+			kept = append(kept, string(m["i"].(json.Number)))
+		}
+	}
+	for _, want := range []string{"0", "42", "99"} {
+		if !slices.Contains(kept, want) {
+			t.Errorf("item %s dropped; kept %v", want, kept)
+		}
+	}
+	if len(kept) > 7 {
+		t.Errorf("kept %d items, want about 6", len(kept))
+	}
+}

+
+func empty(v any) bool {
+	switch v := v.(type) {
+	case nil:
+		return true
+	case string:
+		return v == ""
+	case []any:
+		return len(v) == 0
+	case map[string]any:
+		return len(v) == 0
+	}
+	return false
+}
